attchmntText: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Transfer Of Equity Shares by Mahindra & Mahindra Employees  Stock Option Trust to the Stock Option Grantees'.
voiceSummary: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited transferred equity shares from the Mahindra & Mahindra Employees’ Stock Option Trust to stock option grantees on 13th November 2026. The transfer was executed pursuant to the exercise of stock options granted under the Company’s Employees’ Stock Option Scheme. The company submitted the list of grantees and the corresponding number of equity shares to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, BSE Limited, Luxembourg Stock Exchange, and London Stock Exchange Plc. The announcement includes an annexure detailing the names of the grantees and the total number of equity shares transferred to each individual.

attchmntText: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange about Participation in Investor Meeting
voiceSummary: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited participated in the BOFA India Autos Boardroom Series on 12th November 2026 in Mumbai. The event concluded at 2:00 p.m. IST. The company engaged with funds and investors. The presentation was submitted to the stock exchanges on 5th November 2026. It was presented during the event. The presentation is available on the company website. The link is M&M Q2F27 Analyst Meet – Presentations deck – 5th November 2026. The company referred to publicly available documents. No unpublished price sensitive information was shared.

attchmntText: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange about the Production, Sales and Export figures of the Company for the Month of October 2026
voiceSummary: Mahindra and Mahindra submitted its production, sales, and export figures for October 2026 to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The report details monthly performance data for various vehicle categories including utility vehicles, vans, e-rickshaws, e-carts, and three-wheelers. Sales figures for utility vehicles show a total of 123,752 units in October 2026 compared to 94,873 units in October 2025. Commercial vehicle sales totaled 126,706 units in October 2026 versus 118,097 units in the previous year. Export sales reached 7,241 units in October 2026, up from 4,079 units in October 2025. The data includes sales from subsidiary companies Mahindra Electric Automobile Limited and Mahindra Last Mile Mobility Limited. The figures are unaudited and subject to final verification.

attchmntText: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of M&M Analyst Meet Q2F27
voiceSummary: Mahindra and Mahindra submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. Consolidated revenue rose 25% to Rs. 57,553 crores, with profit after tax increasing 25% to Rs. 4,588 crores. Return on equity stood at 21%. Auto business profit grew 55%, while Farm sector profit declined 9%. Mahindra Finance profit increased 61%, and Tech M profit rose 33%. Logistics showed a significant turnaround, and Accelo profit grew 70%. The company maintained its long-term targets of 15% to 20% EPS growth and 18% RoE. Management highlighted resilience against commodity inflation and geopolitical challenges. No unpublished price sensitive information was shared during the meet. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has intimated the schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings under SEBI regulations. The company will participate in the 29th CITIC CLSA India Forum on 16th November 2026 in Mumbai from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. IST. The Avendus Spark Annual Investor Conference is also scheduled for 16th November 2026 in Mumbai from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. IST. On 17th November 2026, the company will attend the 29th CITIC CLSA India Forum keynote in Mumbai from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. IST and the JM Financial Annual India Conference in Mumbai from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. IST. The Morgan Stanley 25th Annual Asia Pacific Summit will take place on 18th November 2026 in Singapore from 9:30 a.m. to 4:20 p.m. SST. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these events.
